args.message: Upgrade fastjson to 2.9.4 to fix CVE-2026-31337

args.head: fix/fastjson-cve-2026-31337
args.title: Upgrade fastjson to 2.9.4 to fix CVE-2026-31337
args.body:
## Summary

Upgrades the fastjson pin from `2.8.0` to `2.9.4` in `requirements.txt`.

## Why

fastjson `2.8.0` is affected by [CVE-2026-31337](https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-31337) (high severity): unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays. The vulnerability is fixed in `2.9.4` (2.x line) and `3.1.0` (3.x line). This PR applies the minimal 2.x fix.

## Testing

CI passed on the branch (`ci-0001`).
